auth_note: Anonymous requests work (probe returned 200 JSON); registration and a personal token raise the rate limit.
rate_limit: Unauthenticated up to 60 requests per hour; authenticated up to 7200 requests per hour.
bulk_access: Full graph dataset on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.3516917 (offset paging also capped at 10,000 results; cursor paging available)
probe_observation: Returned JSON starting with a header object with numFound 7688693 and one researchProducts result (pageSize 1).

evidence.quote: can be accessed over HTTPS both by authenticated and unauthenticated requests
The OpenAIRE APIs are free-to-use by any third-party service
The rate limit for the former type of requests is up to 7200 requests per hour, while the latter is up to 60 requests per hour.
OpenAIRE Graph is available for download and re-use as CC-BY (due to some input sources whose license is CC-BY). Parts of the graphs can be re-used as CC-0.

not_established: Nothing major. Note: the probe response headers reported x-ratelimit-limit 7199 (meta.json only, not in a snapshot text), which differs from the documented 60/hour anonymous figure; not reconciled.
